# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in full before making changes — it is this
project's contributor conventions doc (dev setup, testing standard,
complexity budget, docs/changelog rules, delivery rules).

If asked to act as one of this repo's milestone-delivery roles (planner,
implementor, reviewer, approver) or to run the delivery loop itself, the
canonical specs live under [docs/agents/](../docs/agents/) and
[docs/workflows/milestone-delivery.md](../docs/workflows/milestone-delivery.md).
Read the relevant one in full — this file does not restate them.
